description: This file defines React components and hooks related to displaying error information in a trace viewer UI, including error rendering, code frame generation, and error model management.

classes.name: ErrorsTabModel
classes.description: Type representing the errors map used in the ErrorsTab component.

classes.name: CopyPromptButton
classes.description: React functional component for copying a prompt to clipboard.

methods.name: useErrorsTabModel
methods.description: Custom hook to create a model of errors from a TraceModel.

methods.name: ErrorView
methods.description: Component to display individual error details, including location and action.

methods.name: ErrorsTab
methods.description: Main React component to display list of errors with context and copy options.

methods.name: codeFrame
methods.description: Function to generate a code frame string highlighting the error location in source code.
